Subject: Hosted API integration architecture review — session scheduling

Hi Alex / MedLytics team,

Thanks again for the quick product evaluation last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused architecture review / technical deep-dive to cover the Hosted API integration for your production use cases (SDK onboarding, streaming, tool/function calling, auth/credentials, and rollout strategy). Goal is to ensure you have a clear integration plan and a mutual action plan for a pilot.

Proposed scope (60–75 minutes):
- Quick intros + roles (5m)
- Overview of your integration goals and constraints (10m)
- SDK options & recommended patterns (streaming vs polling, callbacks) (15m)
- Tool / function-calling examples and security considerations (15m)
- Deployment/rollout checklist + next steps (15m)

Available slots next week (all PT):
- Tue 10 Aug, 10:00–11:15
- Wed 11 Aug, 09:00–10:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Thu 12 Aug, 11:00–12:15

Please share which slot works best and who will join from your side (engineering, security, product). I attached a short proposed agenda and an initial integration checklist for your team to review.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Hi Alex / team — quick prep note ahead of the Thu 12 Aug, 11:00 PT session.

Things that will make the deep-dive highest value:
- A short diagram of your current request flow (where the model call happens) — paste as screenshot in the shared Drive doc.
- Example payloads and typical sequence lengths (average/max tokens).
- Any security or compliance constraints (VPC, KMS, data residency) to highlight during the call.
- A primary use-case you want us to focus on for the function-calling demo (e.g., database lookup, ticket creation, tool invocation).

I've created a shared doc and dropped a lightweight agenda + a sample code snippet for streaming in the Drive link below. If you prefer, we can demo both SDK streaming and raw HTTP streaming paths.

Link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/medlytics-integration-prep

Thanks — Priya
